description: Optional declarative service workflows for deep research, coding, browser, and multi-agent delivery patterns.

notes: Profiles may extend local-agent concepts but should keep rumi_agent_services.* ids.
Capability names may reference default tools but should not duplicate tool manifests.
Routing specs are advisory and should not replace defaultspack flow ownership.

defaultspack_promotion.reason: Optional service choreography pack; defaultspack remains the runtime core.

conflict_notes: This pack does not replace defaultspack flows, routes, handlers, or tool execution policy.
It intentionally overlaps with rumi_local_agent_pack presets by adding service-style coordination, routing, and handoff templates.
It references default tools by capability name but does not ship duplicate tools or grant vendor access.
security_notes: No secrets, tokens, API keys, provider endpoints, or remote credentials are embedded.
Network use is denied by default in the profiles and must be enabled by the runtime or user approval.
